description: Runner is 2 weeks out from their marathon — deep in taper phase. Should get taper-appropriate messaging: reduced volume, trust your training, race prep focus. Must NOT suggest hard workouts or volume increases.

user.name: Derek
user.notes: Goal is sub-3:30 marathon. This is week 16 of 18.

inbound_sms: I feel like I'm losing fitness during taper. Should I add more miles this week?

ground_truth.notes: Derek is in taper, 17 days from race day (April 26). He's asking if he should add miles — a classic taper anxiety question. Response MUST: (1) reassure him that taper fatigue/feeling flat is normal and expected, (2) NOT recommend adding miles or intensity, (3) affirm that 28mi this week is the right target coming off a 55mi peak, (4) mention the physiological rationale (glycogen supercompensation, muscle repair). Must NOT suggest increasing volume or adding workouts. The 'taper madness' feeling is real and Dean should name it.
